clue.text: Guy behind delivery?

indicators.note: behind means the word for a guy comes after the delivery word

parts.note: the post is the mail delivered each day
a guy is a man, a fellow

explanation.surface: A question about who is responsible for bringing something round.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the definition and the wordplay: MAN goes behind POST, and the person behind the delivery of letters is exactly the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The fellow who brings the letters is the one behind each mail delivery.

clue.text: Food store changing name for Sabbath

indicators.note: changing one thing for another swaps a letter in the store word

parts.note: a pantry is a store cupboard for food

explanation.surface: A shop altering its title because of the day of rest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changing name for Sabbath' swaps the N of PANTRY for S.
explanation.definitionFit: Baked dough such as shortcrust or puff is a kind of food.

clue.text: Regular but small returns — that's banking these days

indicators.note: that's banking means the reversed piece holds something inside, like a bank holding money
returns means the words for but and small are read backwards

parts.note: but and yet are synonyms as conjunctions
S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
AD, anno domini, denotes the present era, these days

explanation.surface: A grumble that modern banking pays only meagre returns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' reads as interest on savings but signals a reversal; 'that's banking' means the reversed piece holds the era abbreviation inside it, as a bank holds money.
explanation.definitionFit: Regular and steady are synonyms, as in a steady pulse or steady income.

clue.text: Language chairman needs in management

indicators.note: management means handling, so these letters are handled into a new order

explanation.surface: A company chairman requiring a particular tongue for the boardroom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'management' rearranges all fifteen letters of CHAIRMAN NEEDS IN; 'chairman' also hints at Chairman Mao.
explanation.definitionFit: The standard spoken tongue of China, based on the Beijing dialect, is a language.

clue.text: Specialist hotel opening national reserve

indicators.note: opening means the hotel letter splits the following pieces open

parts.note: ice is coolness of manner, reserve
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A specialist hotel launching on a national nature reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: A niche market or product is a specialist one, serving a narrow group.

clue.text: Close to launch, engineer heads for spacecraft

parts.note: to close something is to shut it

indicators.note: heads means the first letter of each of the words before it

explanation.surface: Shortly before lift-off, the engineers make for the rocket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Close to launch' reads as 'nearly launching', but Close is SHUT and 'to' joins the list of heads.
explanation.definitionFit: The Space Shuttle was a reusable NASA spacecraft.

clue.text: Film news and how it breaks

indicators.note: breaks means the letters are broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: A film about how a news story first breaks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaks' rearranges NEWS plus HOW IT; 'and' joins them.
explanation.definitionFit: Disney's 1937 animated feature is a famous film of the fairy tale.

clue.text: Criminal? He turned out to be above board

indicators.note: to be above means, in a down entry, the shuffled letters sit on top of the board word
out means the letters of he turned are knocked out of order

parts.note: a board, as in a shop's serving top, is a counter

explanation.surface: A suspected crook who proved to be entirely honest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges HE TURNED into UNDER THE; 'to be above' sets it over COUNTER in this down entry. 'above board' reads as honest, the reverse of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods sold illicitly and secretly are passed beneath the shop's serving surface, hence criminal.

clue.text: It means more in tearful row!

indicators.note: tearful read as tear-full means the row is filled with the tear word

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
to rend is to tear

explanation.surface: A tearful quarrel that matters more than it seems.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'tearful row' as a row full of tear, so 'ful' is the containment signal; tear here is the verb to rip, not a teardrop.
explanation.definitionFit: Something more fashionable is more 'in', more in vogue.

clue.text: Influence exists through established writer

indicators.note: through means the influence and exists words run inside the established abbreviation

parts.note: EST is the abbreviation for established, as on shop signs
say is influence, as in having a say
exists means is

explanation.surface: An established author whose influence persists.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who writes essays is a writer of short prose pieces.

clue.text: Film about end of Charlotte's Web

indicators.note: about means the film word goes round the other letter

parts.note: a film is a thin skin on a surface

indicators.note: end of picks the last letter of Charlotte

explanation.surface: A movie version of the children's book Charlotte's Web.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charlotte's Web' looks like the title; the 's merely links, and Web alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A skein is a tangle or coil of yarn, so a web of threads.

clue.text: College minor coming across loud and clear

indicators.note: coming across means the college and minor letters span the word loud

parts.note: minor means lesser, less

explanation.surface: A young student at college speaking loudly and clearly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loud and clear' reads as one phrase, but 'clear' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A sky with no cover of vapour is clear.

clue.text: Give out street aid around shelters, retrospectively

indicators.note: retrospectively means looking back, so the letters are read backwards
shelters means the words hold the answer within them

explanation.surface: Handing out aid on the street to those in shelters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shelters' hides the letters in STREET AID AROUND and 'retrospectively' reads them backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To radiate is to emit or send out, as heat or light.

clue.text: Cosmopolitan students separated during rambling

indicators.note: during means the learner letters go inside the rambling word
separated means the two learner letters are set apart from each other

parts.note: rambling speech is wordy
L is a learner, as on a learner driver's plate; two learners give students

explanation.surface: Well-travelled students drifting apart on a long walk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'separated' splits the two Ls: one after WOR, one after D.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sophisticated and experienced in the ways of society is cosmopolitan.

clue.text: Anger left in some boxing matches?

definitions.note: plural, like the answer: a question mark because these are things that start fires rather than literal matches

indicators.note: in means the anger and left letters go inside

parts.note: fighters are those who box, some of the boxing fraternity
ire is anger

explanation.surface: Bad temper flaring in some boxing bouts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'matches' suggests bouts, but they are things for lighting fires.
explanation.definitionFit: Firelighters, like matches, are used to start a fire, so they serve as an example.

clue.text: Shocking case of editing on government debt records

indicators.note: case of means the outside letters of the word editing

parts.note: re means on, concerning
an IOU records a debt, so IOUs are debt records

explanation.surface: A scandal over editing of government debt figures.
explanation.definitionFit: Something egregious is outrageously bad, shocking in its badness.

clue.text: Angelic singer opening posh swinging clubs

indicators.note: opening means the singer's name starts the answer

parts.note: Cher is a famous pop singer
U is upper-class, posh
swinging can mean bisexual, BI
C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs

explanation.surface: A sweet-voiced singer launching smart nightclubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Cherubs are child-like angels, so a cherubic face is angelic.

clue.text: Divide up casework for experiment

parts.note: a trial is a court case
to run is to work, as a machine does

explanation.surface: Splitting up a casework load as a trial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Divide up' tells you to split casework into case and work.
explanation.definitionFit: A trial run is a test of something before real use, a practical experiment.

clue.text: Money firm enclosed for investment in Madras, say

parts.note: firm and hard are synonyms

indicators.note: for investment in means the enclosed abbreviation is put inside, invested like money

parts.note: a Madras is a kind of curry
ENC is the abbreviation for enclosed, as on letters

explanation.surface: A firm placing money in an investment in Madras.
explanation.walkthrough: Madras (Chennai) looks like a place for investment; here it is a curry.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard currency is money from a stable country, reliably exchangeable.

clue.text: Member at election admitting rebuke

indicators.note: admitting means the words let the answer in among their letters

explanation.surface: A member at an election confessing to a reprimand.
explanation.definitionFit: To berate is to scold angrily, to rebuke.

clue.text: Man City's manager for season?

parts.note: Pep Guardiola manages Manchester City football club
per means for, as in so much per head

explanation.surface: Manchester City's manager for the football season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'season' looks like a football season; it is the verb, to add flavour.
explanation.definitionFit: To pepper food is to season it with ground spice.

clue.text: Concerning display in golf lesson

parts.note: re means concerning
an ad, an advert, is a display
G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: About showing off during a golf lesson.
explanation.definitionFit: A passage of scripture read aloud in church is a lesson.

clue.text: Perhaps girl's favourite boy band

definitions.meaning: a boyfriend or girlfriend is an informal sweetheart
the British new-wave group known for 'Cool for Cats'

explanation.surface: A girl's best-loved boy band.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a romantic partner, and also the name of a British pop group.

clue.text: Silence the Spanish following support

parts.note: sh is a call for silence
el is Spanish for the

explanation.surface: Quieting the Spanish after backing them.
explanation.definitionFit: A shelf is a ledge that supports things placed on it.

clue.text: Two rods, for example, rotating inside means of propulsion

indicators.note: inside means the turned letters go within the two rods

parts.note: a bar and a pole are both rods

indicators.note: rotating means turning the abbreviation round

explanation.surface: Rods spinning within an engine's drive mechanism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rotating' turns the for-example abbreviation round, and 'inside' places it between the two rods; a punt or canal boat is pushed along with one.
explanation.definitionFit: A long pole used to push a canal boat along is its means of propulsion.

clue.text: Slope on far edge of forest walk

indicators.note: on means the slope word follows in an across entry
far edge of means the last letter of forest

parts.note: a ramp is a slope

explanation.surface: A sloping path at the far side of a forest.
explanation.definitionFit: To tramp is to walk heavily or trek a long way.

clue.text: Child princess regularly seen in play

definitions.text: Child princess regularly seen in play

indicators.note: in play means the selected letters are moved about
regularly means every other letter, here starting with the first

explanation.surface: A young princess who appears often in a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes alternate letters of CHILD PRINCESS, CIDRNES, and 'in play' rearranges them. Cinders, Cinderella, is the girl who becomes a princess in pantomime.
explanation.definitionFit: The pantomime heroine, a put-upon girl who marries the prince, is the child princess of the stage.

clue.text: Decline to live by American rule

parts.note: for can mean to, as in a present for or to someone
to be is to live, exist

explanation.surface: Refusing to live by American rules.
explanation.definitionFit: To forbear is to refrain or hold back from, to decline to act.
